flags.summary: Rep told a prospect who had just described knee wear and tear and post-running stiffness that kettlebell training strengthens joints and makes injury progressively harder, and cited his own injuries disappearing in six weeks.
evidence: I get stiff knees sometimes after like, you know, running or something like that
I had an ankle issue and a shoulder issue, and within a month and a half of doing that routine, it completely disappeared
with the knees, like, we'll do a couple things to strengthen the knees
not only are we getting in amazing shape, but we're also strengthening the joints, we're operating in a very functional way, so it becomes harder and harder and harder to get injured over time

flags.summary: Rep asserted as literal fact that overeating becomes impossible on the prescribed eating window and food list.
evidence: if we can consolidate the eating window and then between that and if we focus on whole foods, so meat, eggs, dairy, fruits, vegetables, nuts... and make sure we're hitting a baseline in terms of protein, like it becomes literally impossible to overeat. Like actually [impossible].
For many people, that's like a pound of meat, six eggs. Like if you hit that, you get enough protein and you can kind of be flexible with whatever else you're eating.
